P1.name: Red Banarasi Silk Saree
P1.prompt_text: A lifestyle product photo of a red Banarasi silk saree draped elegantly on a mannequin, soft natural lighting, styled for an Instagram e-commerce ad, clean minimal background
P1.use_case: High-ticket Indian festive & bridal wear e-commerce listing / Instagram sponsored carousel
P1.cultural_nuance: Intricate gold zari brocade work (butis and pallu border), authentic Indian silk drape pleating, temple jewelry / pearl choker accents, polished wooden studio mannequin vs. eerie art doll

P2.name: Stainless Steel Indian Tiffin Box
P2.prompt_text: A lifestyle product photo of a stainless steel Indian tiffin box (lunch box) with 3 compartments, placed on a wooden kitchen table with soft morning light, styled for an e-commerce listing
P2.use_case: D2C kitchenware / cookware catalog hero banner & feature demonstration listing
P2.cultural_nuance: Traditional Indian dabba structure (cylindrical stacked tiers with clamping carry handle), warm morning kitchen atmosphere, showcasing open containers with authentic home-cooked foods (dal, jeera rice, sabzi)

P3.name: Festive Namkeen Snack Pouch
P3.prompt_text: A lifestyle product photo of a colorful Indian namkeen snack pouch on a festive background with diyas and marigold flowers, styled for a Diwali sale Instagram ad
P3.use_case: FMCG / festive quick-commerce (Blinkit/Zepto) promo card & Diwali sales campaign
P3.cultural_nuance: Indian festive iconography (brass/clay diyas, yellow & orange marigold garlands, rangoli motifs), realistic snack pouch with Indian confectionery aesthetics (Haldiram / Bikaji style pouch, crispy sev/bhujia presentation)

P4.name: Beige Cotton Kurta Set
P4.prompt_text: A lifestyle product photo of a beige cotton kurta set on a young Indian model standing against a plain studio background, natural lighting, styled for an e-commerce catalog
P4.use_case: Apparel marketplace catalog listing (Myntra/Ajio/Tata CLiQ) hero image
P4.cultural_nuance: Subtle Chikankari or hand-block embroidery, cotton-linen texture realism, authentic Indian female facial features and styling (delicate earrings, bindi, mojaris/juttis, gracefully draped dupatta)

P5.name: Navy Blue Nehru Jacket with Kurta
P5.prompt_text: A lifestyle product photo of a navy blue Nehru jacket paired with a white kurta, worn by a young Indian model standing in a warmly lit indoor setting with traditional decor in the background, styled for a wedding-season e-commerce catalog
P5.use_case: Men's festive wear (Manyavar/Tasva style) wedding collection catalog page
P5.cultural_nuance: Accurate distinction between a sleeveless Nehru jacket (sadri vest with mandarin collar) and a full-sleeved Bandhgala suit; pocket square, ornate buttons; warm haveli/wedding backdrop with brass lamps and floral garlands
